note: Hand-written, one row per canonical feature. This list is NOT derived by scanning the tree: a guard that only validates the features it already found passes cleanly on a project that has none of them. A row is `built` only when every named artefact exists AND the feature is genuinely finished. Rows that are `open` are expected to be unbuilt and do not fail the guard; a `built` row missing any artefact does.
